Meeting drafts now sync with Parley Cloud, so a meeting you prepare from Claude or ChatGPT shows up on your desktop and reminds you.

**Meeting drafts sync with Parley Cloud** (#686)

- When you're signed in with cloud sync on, your meeting drafts are kept in Parley Cloud as well as on this computer. A draft made on another desktop, or by an AI assistant through the Parley Cloud connector, appears under Upcoming meetings within about two minutes and reminds you before it starts, just like one you made here.
- The Parley Cloud connector for Claude and ChatGPT can now create, list, update and delete meeting drafts, not only read your recordings. Ask it to "prepare tomorrow's 2 pm call with the agenda and background", and the draft is waiting in Parley.
- Edits and deletions go both ways. When the same draft is changed in two places, the most recent change wins. A draft you have open for editing is never changed under you; your next save simply wins.
- Whether a reminder has already fired stays per computer, so each of your desktops reminds you once.
- Settings › Account now lists meeting drafts among what cloud sync covers.
